item.title: Loughman signs 2 year contract extension
item.description: Jeremy Loughman has signed a 2 year contract extension with Munster, keeping him at the province until 20-28. He has established himself as a key member of the squad since joining in December 20-17. The powerful loosehead prop has scored six tries in 127 appearances for the province, along with earning five caps for Ireland. item.title: Report that ICE agents will have security role at Winter Olympics
item.description: The Associated Press is reporting that ICE agents will have security role at the upcoming Winter Olympics in Italy. Officers would support diplomatic security details at the Milan Cortina Games and not run any immigration enforcement. Milan's mayor Giuseppe Sala has said on Italian radio that the force would not be welcome in his city. Advertisement

item.title: Spain to host 2030 World Cup final
item.description: The president of Spain's football federation says the 2030 men's World Cup final will be staged in the country. The tournament is being co?hosted by Spain, Portugal and Morocco, with the opening three matches held in South America to mark the World Cup's centenary. Morocco had shown interest in hosting the final, but Rafael Louzan insists Spain will lead host the showpiece. Advertisement

item.title: Emergency response service charity tasked to Kerry 98 times last year
item.description: A charity which provides an emergency response service was tasked to Kerry 98 times last year. CRITICAL was first established in 2009 as Irish Community Rapid Response and in 2019 it launched Ireland’s first and only charity air ambulance. The air ambulance is now funded by the State, and CRITICAL consists of a network of volunteers that respond alongside the National Ambulance Service when 999 or 112 is called. item.description: Kerry County Council is dealing with over 200 (205) open case files for derelict sites. item.title: Liverpool boss doesn't expect Robertson to leave club
item.description: Liverpool boss Arne Slot doesn't expect Andy Robertson to leave the club during the January transfer window. Tottenham have held talks with the Merseysiders about a possible move for the defender, whose contract expires at the end of the season. Slot says Robertson is a valued member of his squad. item.title: Organisers of Dublin Racing Festival confident it will go ahead as planned
item.description: Organisers of this weekend's Dublin Racing Festival at Leopardstown are confident that it will go ahead as planned, despite the effects of Storm Chandra. 60 millimetres of rain fell on Monday, leaving the track unfit for racing this afternoon. There are four Grade Ones on the card for the first day of the Festival on Saturday. Advertisement
